public_rationale: Reuters documented a CoreWeave bond yield briefly above 16%, showing real credit-market stress. That does not establish an actual borrowing cost, default or widespread inability to service debt because of thin margins. CoreWeave's earlier financing announcement provides limited contrary context, but cannot refute an eventual forecast. No event meeting the early-resolution rule was established by October 28.
limitations: Accessible evidence is concentrated on CoreWeave rather than a representative borrower population.
Market stress can precede distress, but it is not itself proof of the predicted outcome.
The unspecified accounting basis prevents a definitive matched financial comparison.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI data center debt will eventually become untenable because 11%+ rates on thin margins don't work.

statement.excerpt: Eventually, AI data center debt is going to become untenable for those raising it, because 11%+ rates on already-meager margins makes the maths a little impossible.

our_interpretation: The plain reading predicts financial unsustainability across a meaningful part of the relevant AI data-center borrowing market, rather than one isolated unsuccessful project.
'Untenable' means borrowers cannot sustainably service or refinance their debt, evidenced by defaults, distressed restructurings or financing failures.
The causal explanation requires actual financing costs of at least 11% and inadequate operating cash flows. A secondary-market yield is not automatically the borrower's contractual interest rate.
The surrounding discussion includes modeled refinancing costs. It supplies no deadline or precise share of borrowers.
criteria.support_condition: Representative borrower or project records show widespread debt-service or refinancing failures caused materially by borrowing costs of at least 11% interacting with insufficient operating margins.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A clearly defined relevant debt population reaches final repayment or resolution without the predicted unsustainability, despite the stated financing costs. Temporary access to capital cannot refute an unrestricted eventual forecast.

evidence.locator: Section: DEBT MARKET JITTERS, first paragraph
evidence.explanation: This documents substantial credit-market stress after the post. A traded bond yield above 11% does not establish an actual refinancing at that rate, a default or the sector-wide cash-flow mechanism.

The company reported successful financing before the post, which limits any reading that financing was already universally unavailable. It does not establish the all-in rate without SOFR or refute eventual distress.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Representative borrower records linking defaults, distressed restructurings or failed refinancing to actual rates of at least 11% and inadequate cash flows, or final contrary outcomes for a clearly defined debt population.
